character: 125 km, budget-friendly, excellent snow record (north-facing), uncrowded. Best value in the Maurienne valley.
name: Val Cenis
description: 125km of pistes, 27 lifts, in the Haute Maurienne valley on the Italian border. 5 villages: Lanslebourg, Lanslevillard, Termignon, Sollières-Sardières, and Bramans. The historic Mont Cenis pass (Hannibal's route). Known for: quiet slopes, excellent value, the Mont Cenis plateau, and being one of the snow-sure lower-altitude domains thanks to its north-easterly exposure. Snowmaking on all major runs.
